newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel still a buy.

text.p: -- Flemings Research said in a report it was maintaining its long-term buy rating on Parana state power utility Copel.
-- It said Copel is a "charter member of our High Growth Club with a 6.7 percent boost in firm energy sales during 1996 after an 8.8 percent increase in 1995."
-- Copel is expected to post higher earnings once the pending regulation of Brazil's electricity industry becomes reality, it said.
-- Copel preferred B shares were off 0.7 percent 14.20 reais.
